name: Stanford COVID Vaccine mRNA 1st Place — Per-Nucleotide Degradation Prediction
summary: Dual-branch neural architecture combining bidirectional RNN on raw RNA sequences with GCN on secondary-structure adjacency matrices, fused at every sequence position and decoded with a linear head to predict per-nucleotide degradation rates.
dejargonized_summary: Predict how fast each position in an RNA strand degrades by reading the sequence left-to-right and right-to-left with one model, while a second model reasons about which bases are physically paired, then merging both views before making the final prediction.

inputs.name: rna_sequence
inputs.constraints: RNA nucleotide string (A, U, G, C). Variable length.

inputs.name: secondary_structure
inputs.constraints: Dot-bracket notation string encoding base-pair structure, same length as rna_sequence.

outputs.name: degradation_rates
outputs.constraints: Shape (L, 5): per-nucleotide predictions for reactivity, deg_Mg_pH10, deg_pH10, deg_Mg_50C, deg_50C.

planning_constraints.subject: structure_before_graph
planning_constraints.statement: Secondary structure parsing must precede graph neural network training.
planning_constraints.rationale: The GCN operates on adjacency matrices derived from predicted base pairings; without parsed structure there is no graph to convolve over.

planning_constraints.subject: fusion_after_branches
planning_constraints.statement: Feature fusion must follow both the sequence-to-sequence model and the graph neural network.
planning_constraints.rationale: Fusion concatenates the hidden states from both branches; both must produce outputs before merging is possible.

stages.name: Secondary Structure Parsing
stages.description: Convert RNA sequence strings into adjacency matrices encoding base-pair connectivity using Arnie/ViennaRNA thermodynamic folding predictions.
stages.dejargonized_description: Use physics-based RNA folding software to predict which bases in the strand pair up, and store those pairings as a connectivity matrix.

outputs.name: adjacency_matrix
outputs.constraints: Shape (L, L): binary or probabilistic adjacency encoding base pairs.

preconditions: Input sequence and structure strings have equal length.
guarantees: Output is a symmetric (L, L) matrix with ones at paired positions.
family_notes: Uses Arnie wrapper around ViennaRNA to compute base-pair probability matrices.
Multiple folding algorithms can be ensembled for more robust structure predictions.

stages.name: Node Feature Generation
stages.description: Compute per-nucleotide features (one-hot nucleotide type, positional encoding) and per-edge features (base-pair probabilities from the adjacency matrix).
stages.dejargonized_description: Build a feature vector for each position in the RNA describing what nucleotide it is and how strongly it pairs with other positions.

outputs.name: edge_features
outputs.constraints: Shape (E, D_edge): per-edge feature vectors for graph edges.

preconditions: Adjacency matrix and sequence are available and length-consistent.
guarantees: Node features cover all L positions. Edge features cover all nonzero adjacency entries.

stages.name: Sequence-to-Sequence Model
stages.description: Train a bidirectional GRU/LSTM on the 1D RNA sequence to produce per-position hidden states capturing long-range sequential context.
stages.dejargonized_description: Read the RNA sequence forwards and backwards with a recurrent neural network to build a context-aware representation at each position.

outputs.name: rnn_hidden_states
outputs.constraints: Shape (L, H_rnn): per-position hidden states from bidirectional RNN.

preconditions: Node features are computed for all positions.
guarantees: Output has one hidden vector per sequence position.
family_notes: Uses PyTorch bidirectional GRU or LSTM.
Captures sequential dependencies that the graph branch may miss.

stages.name: Graph Neural Network
stages.description: Train a GCN on the adjacency matrices to produce per-node embeddings that capture structural (base-pairing) context, in parallel with the sequence branch.
stages.dejargonized_description: Use a graph neural network to learn representations based on which bases are physically paired together in the RNA's 3D structure.

outputs.name: gcn_embeddings
outputs.constraints: Shape (L, H_gcn): per-node embeddings from GCN.

preconditions: Adjacency matrix and node features are available.
guarantees: Output has one embedding vector per nucleotide node.
family_notes: Runs in parallel with the sequence-to-sequence model branch.

stages.name: Feature Fusion
stages.description: Concatenate RNN hidden states and GCN embeddings at every sequence position to form a unified representation combining sequential and structural information.
stages.dejargonized_description: Merge the sequence-reading model's output with the structure-reading model's output at each RNA position.

outputs.name: fused_features
outputs.constraints: Shape (L, H_rnn + H_gcn): concatenated per-position features.

guarantees: Output dimension is the sum of both branch hidden dimensions.

stages.name: Output Head
stages.description: Linear layer mapping fused features to per-nucleotide degradation rate predictions across 5 target columns.
stages.dejargonized_description: A simple linear layer that converts the merged representation into the final degradation rate predictions for each position.

outputs.name: degradation_rates
outputs.constraints: Shape (L, 5): predictions for reactivity, deg_Mg_pH10, deg_pH10, deg_Mg_50C, deg_50C.

preconditions: Fused features available for all positions.
guarantees: Output covers all scored positions with 5 target values each.

edges.provenance: Base-pair adjacency from RNA folding prediction.
Per-nucleotide feature vectors for RNN input.
Per-nucleotide feature vectors for GCN input.
Structure adjacency for GCN message passing.
Per-position sequential context from bidirectional RNN.

audit.rationale: 1st place Kaggle Stanford COVID Vaccine solution. Dual-branch architecture fusing bidirectional RNN (sequential) and GCN (structural) for per-nucleotide mRNA degradation prediction.
audit.dejargonized_summary: Predict how fast each part of an RNA molecule degrades by combining a model that reads the sequence linearly with one that understands the physical pairing structure.
provenance_notes: Source: Kaggle Stanford COVID Vaccine competition, 1st place (2020)
uncertainty_notes: Exact GRU vs LSTM choice and hidden dimensions depend on final hyperparameter sweep.
Secondary structure quality depends on ViennaRNA/Arnie accuracy for the given sequences.
